name: LIM domain only 2
pathways: positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II

function.text: LMO2 encodes rhombotin-2. Annotated molecular activities include transcription coactivator activity and transcription coregulator binding. It participates in positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and embryonic hemopoiesis.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include T-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.
